mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT m.id, COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) AS currency FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN ledger_account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' AND a.owner_id = m.id AND a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') AND a.status = 1
GROUP BY m.id, COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) ) t

SELECT m.tenant_id AS tenantId, m.id AS merchantId, m.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, m.merchant_short_name AS merchantShortName, m.status AS status, m.risk_status AS riskStatus, COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_AVAILABLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS availableBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_FROZEN' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS frozenBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingSettleBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'MERCHANT_AVAILABLE' THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS effectiveBalance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') THEN b.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalBalance, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.id) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasLedgerAccount, MAX(b.last_posted_at) AS lastPostedAt FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN ledger_account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' AND a.owner_id = m.id AND a.account_type IN ('MERCHANT_AVAILABLE', 'MERCHANT_FROZEN', 'MERCHANT_PENDING_SETTLE') AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ledger_balance b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY m.tenant_id, m.id, m.merchant_no, m.merchant_name, m.merchant_short_name, m.status, m.risk_status, COALESCE(a.currency, m.default_currency) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{params.limitValue} OFFSET #{params.offset}
